capabilities: Build downscaled proxy copies of canvas images in multiple resolution tiers
Swap original images for size-matched proxies while zooming and restore originals when zoomed in
Cache proxies in IndexedDB with LRU eviction under a configurable memory budget
Restore original images on the current canvas or clear the proxy cache via commands
Prewarm proxies by reading the canvas JSON for off-screen nodes
extras: Desktop only; the author explains mobile is unsupported because WebKit canvas WebP encoding and WebView memory limits need separate work. Installation is manual file copying. Proxies (roughly 100 MB on a large vault) are stored in IndexedDB outside the vault so they are not synced; the cache self-invalidates when an image is edited.
intentEvidence: Removes zoom lag in Obsidian Canvas on boards with many large images.
problem: Obsidian Canvas re-rasterizes every image from full source resolution on each zoom step, so boards with many large images stutter while zooming.
summary: Performance plugin that swaps large Canvas images for downscaled proxies matched to zoom level, removing zoom lag on image-heavy boards.
